name: giant rat
desc: A big rat the size of a dog with red eyes.

name: giant wolf
desc: A giant wolf with gray-black fur and green eyes.

name: giant spider
desc: Furry cave spider with eight eyes staring at you.

name: gargoyle
desc: A gargoyle made of rock with red eyes flashing.

name: ghost
desc: The translucent spirit body exudes cold air.

name: shadow beast
desc: A beast formed from darkness, with only a pair of red eyes clearly visible.

name: forest troll
desc: A three-meter-tall troll with skin as rough as tree bark.

name: young dragon
desc: The young dragon has been sleeping for many years, its scales shine like obsidian.

name: Goblin
desc: The little green-skinned man was holding a broken knife and screaming.

name: goblin shaman
desc: The goblin wearing a bone mask exudes evil energy.

name: giant python
desc: A giant python as thick as a bucket, its scales gleaming in the dark.

name: bandit leader
desc: The one-eyed man with a sinewy face was holding a long sword stained with blood.

name: ice element
desc: A humanoid creature made of ice crystals, exuding a biting cold air.

name: Mimic
desc: It looks like a gorgeous treasure chest...but it has teeth!

name: Dryad
desc: Ancient trees come to life, waving their vine-like branches.

name: giant eagle
desc: A giant eagle with a wingspan of five meters, its beak is like an iron hook, and its eyes are like torches.

name: Goblin King
desc: Three times the size of an ordinary goblin, he wears a bone crown on his head and holds a giant stick!

name: Wraith
desc: The translucent humanoid resentful spirit made a low cry, and everything it passed was covered with frost.

name: Basilisk
desc: A huge lizard with a red crown on its back that turns everything it looks at to stone!

name: security drone
desc: The autonomous patrol drone left behind by the Foundation has its red scanning light locked on you.

name: mimetic staff
desc: Something in a Foundation uniform, its face a blur of flesh.

name: Out of control abnormal core
desc: The anomalous entity leaked after the containment column shattered. Its shape is constantly changing, and the air is distorted by it.

name: Concrete Sculpture (SCP-ZH-173)
desc: A human sculpture covered in red paint and dirt. When you blink, it has moved closer.

name: The Shy One (SCP-ZH-096)
desc: A pale and tall human figure, covering his face with his hands. Anyone who sees his face will be hunted.

name: Rotten Old Man (SCP-ZH-106)
desc: Corrosive old man, able to seep out of walls. Metal rusts wherever it passes.

name: Immortal Creeper (SCP-ZH-682)
desc: Huge, abominable reptilian creatures, extremely adaptable. After defeating it, the door to the Terminal 001 Storage Vault will open.

name: Final Prototype (SCP-ZH-001)
desc: The product of failed containment in the deepest part of the site - the "prototype" of all anomalies. This is the ultimate threat to Foundation site operations.

dialog.taunt: ...What you see is just the beginning.

name: Multithroated Hunter (SCP-ZH-939)
desc: The eyeless red predator can imitate human cries for help.

name: Prey Latent Image (SCP-ZH-966)
desc: A nearly invisible humanoid that attacks its prey when it is tired.

name: Abel (SCP-ZH-076)
desc: The black-haired warrior woke up from his sarcophagus, bone blade in hand, wanting nothing more than to fight.

name: Shadow Man (SCP-ZH-017)
desc: A human silhouette in absolute darkness, swallowing up all the light that shines on it.

name: Construction Bear (SCP-ZH-1048)
desc: A seemingly harmless brown teddy bear with an unknown substance oozing from its joints.

name: Yu Guangren (SCP-ZH-372)
desc: A creature that always stays at the edge of your field of vision and disappears as soon as you turn your head.

name: Human (SCP-ZH-3199)
desc: A humanoid egg-laying predator with a shrill scream.
